Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran` (merge `origin/main` first if it refuses as STALE TREE); `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Build the closure your tests import first (`bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '<pkg>^...' build"`). Changeset in the root `.changeset/` for each published package your diff changes (app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green. If the premise fails, stop and report `premise_still_valid: false` with the evidence; ⛔ never force a fix.


### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

The picker's own read rule decides what it draws: `RecordPickerDialog` drops a column the viewer may not read (`readableColumns`). Do not add a second permission check, and do not fetch the email some other way.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` 9f760377 (read-only):
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionHoldersSection.tsx` ≈L389 passes no `columns` and no `displayField` to `RecordPickerDialog` on `sys_user`, so the dialog draws only its default display column (`RecordPickerDialog.tsx` ≈L358 / ≈L596).
- The section's holder rows build their label at ≈L87 (`full_name || name || display_name || email || id`) and show `email` underneath (≈L363–366). Measure which `sys_user` field holds the display name in the served schema. Do not hard-code a guess.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

1. Pass `columns` = the user's display field + `email`. If the dialog takes `objectSchema` for title resolution, pass what the section already has rather than fetching again.
2. Tests:
   - the picker draws an email column;
   - CONTROL: selection still adds the holder;
   - CONTROL: a viewer without read on `email` gets the name column only, if the harness can express it (otherwise say so in the report);
   - ablation: drop `columns`, and the email-column test goes red.

### Scope

File surface:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PositionHoldersSection.tsx`
- tests beside it
- root `.changeset/`

Do not edit `ui/packages/fields/**`.

### Tier

`TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `low` (S). `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`. Not governed. Changeset: app-shell is private, so follow the #27389 precedent (`@object-ui/console` patch).
